notes: Mathlib proof A025191_conjecture: for n >= 1, a(n) = A027914(n) - A027914(n-1) and a(n) = (A081673(n) - A081673(n-1))/2, A081673 defined by its e.g.f. in Q[[X]]. Via row symmetry of trinomial coefficients (Polynomial.reflect), 2 A027914(n) = 3^n + central trinomial, and A081673(n) = 2 A027914(n) - 1. Outside Lean: I0(2x) = sum x^(2j)/(j!)^2 (series of the Bessel function); OEIS terms checked in Python only.
